details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2867-2873 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In _heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api, the divergence skip guard (`divergence_target="${TARGET_BRANCH_DEFAULT:-}"` / `[ "${divergence_target}" != "${divergence_default}" ]`) compares the operator default (WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH, default `stable`) with PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH. It should compare the report's effective target: HEAD_BRANCH, with the promote-candidate mirror retargeted to PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH as at lines 3499-3505.
  WHY: A self-repo workflow_run report on `main` still spends a GET on `repos/<self>/compare/stable...main` from the GH_PAT budget and adds an irrelevant or misleading `### Branch divergence` section, even though the fix lands on main. test_intake_evidence_pack_lists_issue_runs_and_divergence_within_budget locks this behaviour in, and test_intake_evidence_pack_skips_divergence_when_target_is_default only covers WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH=main. Severity MAJOR from all four reviewers; minimax confidence 3, others 4.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1233 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In branch_divergence, `truncated = total_commits > len(commits_raw) or len(commits_raw) >= COMPARE_COMMIT_CAP or len(files_raw) >= COMPARE_FILE_CAP` uses `>=`, so a complete response at exactly the cap is flagged as truncated.
  WHY: A stable...main range of exactly 250 commits gets a false "(truncated: the compare response hit GitHub's 250-commit or 300-file limit)" note that contradicts `total_commits=250`. Reviewers disagree on the file term. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says the `>= 300` file check is still needed because the response has no file total, and only the commit term should go. gemini, minimax and glm also flag exactly 300 files, and glm suggests strict `>` for both caps. All rate it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1341-1365 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In _build_evidence_pack, the heading `Runs started for issue #{entry_number}` sits outside the fenced block. When the number is a SOURCE_REPO (consumer) issue number, it autolinks to that issue number in SELF_REPO, the repo where the heal issue is filed.
  WHY: GitHub links the heading to an unrelated coding-workflows issue (possibly an orchestrator tracking issue) and posts a "mentioned this issue" event on it, which misleads the diagnosis model and operators. Reports from this repo also post extra backlinks. Suggested fix: write "issue number {entry_number}" or put `#N` in a code span. Source severity MAJOR.
- agents.d/heal-evidence-pack-issue-runs.md, changelog.d/heal-evidence-pack-issue-runs.md:(fragment filenames) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment filenames omit the `<issue-or-pr>-<slug>` prefix (e.g. `8475-heal-evidence-pack-issue-runs.md`).
  WHY: Purely cosmetic: the assemblers treat names as opaque and sibling fragments use the same shape. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this finding because the linked issue's "Expected files" list names exactly these filenames. Source severity NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Skip it [branch_divergence] when the target branch is the default branch."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, _heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api divergence guard
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The guard compares only TARGET_BRANCH_DEFAULT (`WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH`, default stable) with PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH. No hunk uses the report's real target (HEAD_BRANCH, with the promote-candidate mirror switched to the default branch), even though that value is known at intake. A main-targeted self-repo heal therefore still gets the compare. This is the same root cause as the intake.sh:2867-2873 finding. Source severity MAJOR.
- requirement: "Fetch the title with one `GET repos/<repo>/issues/<n>` per issue, unless the title already appears in the log."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py `extract_issue_refs` / `evidence-pack-requests`; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh `_heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api` (issue-read loop around line 2844)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `extract_issue_refs` returns only integer issue numbers (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1047-1075). The intake unconditionally GETs `repos/${SOURCE_REPO}/issues/${issue_number}` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2844) and never reuses a title already present in the log. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 lists this as not a gap: it stays within the 2-read budget, and the agents fragment documents it as deliberate (titles come from the API, never from the attacker-writable log). Source severity NIT.
- requirement: "API budget, asserted with a fake `gh`: at most 7 calls per report (4 runs pages, 2 issue reads, 1 compare)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh `_heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api`; changelog.d/heal-evidence-pack-issue-runs.md; agents.d/heal-evidence-pack-issue-runs.md; tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py `test_intake_evidence_pack_lists_issue_runs_and_divergence_within_budget`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The code shares at most 2 runs-list pages across issues (the `for runs_page in 1 2` loop), so the real cap is 5 calls, while the test still asserts `len(extra) <= 7`. The "4 runs pages" to "2 runs pages" change has no test or doc delta explaining it. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash list this as not a gap because 5 calls is strictly within the cap of 7. Source severity NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:_build_evidence_pack, line 1341 (rendered at line 1365); fed by scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh _heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The heading `### Runs started for issue #{entry_number}` sits outside the fence and uses a SOURCE_REPO issue number. The heal issue is always filed in SELF_REPO (`_open_issue "${SELF_REPO}" "${TARGET_BRANCH}"` at intake line 3578 and line 3610), and the `SOURCE_REPO == SELF_REPO` check guards only divergence.
  WHY: For a consumer report that names `issue #42`, GitHub links the heading to unrelated coding-workflows issue #42 and posts a "mentioned this issue" event on it. Fix (~2 lines plus tests): use `Runs started for issue number {entry_number}` or a code span.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:_heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api, line 2867 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `divergence_target="${TARGET_BRANCH_DEFAULT:-}"` (line 239: `${WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH:-stable}`) compares the operator default with the default branch instead of the heal issue's target. That target is HEAD_BRANCH (Route block, lines 3496-3498), with promote-candidate switched to PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH (lines 3499-3505). HEAD_BRANCH is set at line 387. See also docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md line 208.
  WHY: A self-repo workflow_run on main still gets a GET on `repos/<self>/compare/stable...main` and a misleading `### Branch divergence` section. test_intake_evidence_pack_lists_issue_runs_and_divergence_within_budget locks this in, and test_intake_evidence_pack_skips_divergence_when_target_is_default only covers WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH=main. Fix (~4 lines): `divergence_target="${HEAD_BRANCH:-${TARGET_BRANCH_DEFAULT:-}}"` plus the mirror mapping.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:branch_divergence, `truncated = total_commits > len(commits_raw) or len(commits_raw) >= COMPARE_COMMIT_CAP or len(files_raw) >= COMPARE_FILE_CAP` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `len(commits_raw) >= 250` term fires on a complete 250-commit response.
  WHY: It shows a false truncation note next to `total_commits=250`. The `>= 300` file check is still needed because the response has no file total. Fix: remove the commit-cap term.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Skip it [branch_divergence] when the target branch is the default branch."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, the divergence guard in _heal_fetch_evidence_pack_api
  Evidence of absence: The guard compares only TARGET_BRANCH_DEFAULT with PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH, and no hunk uses HEAD_BRANCH or the mirror mapping. Same root cause as the CORRECTNESS finding.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Not gaps (2 related items): (1) Sharing 2 runs pages across issues means at most 5 calls, which meets "at most 7 calls". (2) Always fetching the issue title stays within the 2-read budget and is documented as deliberate (titles come from the API, never from the log).
- Pre-push failures not caused by this diff: tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py::test_label_contract_and_reporter_skip (intake line 1811 still comes before line 1816) and tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py (reads only workflow YAML).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS mirror the three findings above (divergence guard 2-3 lines; heading 1 line plus test strings; truncation term 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
